zh.title: GR00T训练后部署在真机上测试
zh.summary: 本次测试覆盖了 7 项操作任务，每项任务均采集了 100 条示范数据。模型在基础的 Pick-and-Place 任务中表现较好，但在叠杯等难度更高的任务中稳定性有所下降。初步分析认为，当前系统仅使用第三视角相机，缺少腕部相机提供近距离视觉反馈，可能限制了模型对精细操作状态的感知能力。

en.title: Real-Robot Evaluation after GR00T Training
en.summary: This evaluation covered seven manipulation tasks, with 100 demonstrations collected for each task. The model performed well on basic pick-and-place tasks, but its reliability decreased on more challenging tasks such as cup stacking. My initial assessment is that the current setup relies on a single third-person camera and lacks a wrist-mounted camera for close-range visual feedback, which may limit the model's ability to perceive fine-grained manipulation states.
